name: The Strand of Wrath
description: Magic that anger feeds: fire, force, blood and breaking. Loose, it turns a quarrel into a feud and a feud into a war.

name: The Strand of Dread
description: Magic that fear feeds: shadow, hiding, flight and phantoms; the step that vanishes, and the shape at the edge of the light.

name: The Strand of Envy
description: Magic that envy feeds: taking another's face, voice, shape or goods; the counterfeit and the swap.

name: The Strand of Sorrow
description: Magic that sorrow feeds: water, rain and tide, and memory, which it can drown or bring back.

name: The Strand of Despair
description: Magic that despair feeds: death, decay and the dead; what stops, and what will not.

name: The Strand of Pride
description: Magic that pride feeds: command, oaths and the binding of wills; the word that makes a crowd kneel.

name: The Strand of Delight
description: Magic that delight feeds: plenty, growth, healing and charm; bread from nothing, a wound closed, a stranger beloved.
